01
1 / 2
Web App
Hazardhub

data management and reporting platform designed for a hazard monitoring and incident response organization. The dashboard enables administrators to log, track, and analyze hazard incidents with severity classifications — high, medium, and low — alongside resolution statuses. It includes dynamic data visualization using Chart.js for trend analysis across reporting periods, tabular incident management with search, filtering by date range and category, and in-line editing capabilities. A standout feature is the Investigation Report module, a structured digital form that guides staff through a standardized incident investigation workflow, complete with cost tracking, body map indicators, witness fields, and a dual-signature sign-off section. Reports can be saved as templates or submitted directly. The platform also supports Excel export via SheetJS, allowing administrators to generate downloadable reports for compliance and record-keeping purposes.

02
Web App
Carmona Estates - HOA System

A full-stack web application built for the administrative staff of Carmona Estates, a multi-phase residential community. The system provides a centralized dashboard for managing homeowner affairs across multiple office scopes, with role-based access control distinguishing between super admins, office admins, and staff. Key features include appointment scheduling and status management, resident complaint tracking with resolution workflows, automated email notification previews before sending, real-time data refresh, and phase-based filtering so each office only sees records relevant to their jurisdiction. The interface surfaces live statistics on pending and resolved cases, and all status updates trigger editable email drafts that admins can review, modify, or skip before confirming. Built with vanilla JavaScript on the frontend and a REST API backend, the application handles session-based authentication and enforces data scoping server-side.
